name: TimeSpanSelectorView
tagline: Custom Android view library for radial and linear time range selection.
description:
TimeSpanSelectorView is a highly customizable, open-source Android view library for selecting time spans. It includes Circular (Radial) and Linear layouts with Material 3 styling.

Built in Java and Kotlin with extensive unit and UI test coverage (TimeSpanSelectorUITest, TimeSpanSelectorCoverageTest).

Highlights:
- Dual Selector Components: CircularTimeSpanSelector (radial clock dial) and LinearTimeSpanSelector (horizontal slider) to match any UX design.
- Blocked Time Intervals: Lock or gray out unselectable time slots (BlockedInterval.java) for appointment booking and shift scheduling.
- Overnight Span Support: Handles time spans that cross midnight (start time > end time) for sleep trackers and night shifts.
- Customization Attributes: Configure track colors, stroke widths, tick mark counts, step snap intervals (1, 5, 15, 30 min), and custom thumb drawables.
